scripts.build: GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -buildvcs=false -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o bin/panel-host-bridge ./cmd/panel-host-bridge
scripts.test: sh -c '[ "$(go env GOOS)" = linux ] && go test -race -count=1 ./... || echo "[bridge] skipping go test: Linux-only syscalls, run on a Linux host or in CI"'
scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 && GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -buildvcs=false -o /dev/null ./... || echo "[bridge] skipping go typecheck: go not on PATH (compilation is covered by the go CI job)"'
